The following events took place in '''3622 BBY'''.<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>

==Events==
*[[Czerka Interstellar]] develops a [[Czerka Phase Three Adrenal Combat Enhancers|combat enhancement boost]]<ref name="Research and Destruction">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Galactic Season 8: Research and Destruction}}</ref> and its [[Czerka Experimental Combat Enhancer Mk. 2|upgraded version]].<ref name="Trial by Firepower">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Galactic Season 9: Trial by Firepower}}</ref>
*[[Sa'har Kateen]] is brought to the [[Hidden Chain]] by [[Ri'kan Kateen]] following the [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|Hidden Chain flagship incident]].<ref name="The Master's Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|The [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']]}}</ref>
*[[Kai Zykken]] becomes the [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of [[Combat Enhancement Synergy]] for Czerka Interstellar.<ref name="Trial by Firepower" />
*The ''[[Jannimak]]'' [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashes]] into the [[Jannimak crash site|surface]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Crash Site Outpost">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Crash Site Outpost}}</ref>
